## What Happened

In this challenge, a successful exploitation of server-side template injection (SSTI) was achieved. After determining that the template engine was Jinja2/Twig, the analyst utilized the 'ssti_exploit_suggester' to generate payloads that could run arbitrary commands on the server, leading to retrieving the flag. The approach worked because it effectively leveraged Jinja2's capability to execute Python expressions within templates, specifically accessing the OS module to read files. For future attempts, integrating earlier checks for template engines could expedite the exploit development process, along with exploring additional payloads better suited for particular input contexts and refining the identification of vulnerable endpoints.
